Description The INA240 device is a voltage-output, current-sense amplifier with enhanced PWM rejection that can sense drops across shunt resistors over a wide common-mode voltage range from –4 V to 80 V, independent of the supply voltage. The negative common-mode voltage allows the device to operate below ground, accommodating the flyback period of typical solenoid applications. Enhanced PWM rejection provides high levels of suppression for large common-mode transients (ΔV/Δt) in systems that use pulse width modulation (PWM) signals (such as motor drives and solenoid control systems). This feature allows for accurate current measurements without large transients and associated recovery ripple on the output voltage. Datasheet

DESCRIPTION :The TP4056 is a complete constant-current/constant-voltage linear charger for single cell lithium-ion batteries. Its SOP package and low external component count make the TP4056 ideally suited for portable applications. Furthermore, the TP4056 can work within USB and wall adapter. No blocking diode is required due to the internal PMOSFET architecture and have prevent to negative Charge Current Circuit. Thermal feedback regulates the charge current to limit the die temperature during high power operation or high ambient temperature. The charge voltage is fixed at 4.2V, and the charge current can be programmed externally with a single resistor. The TP4056 automatically terminates the charge cycle when the charge current drops to 1/10th the programmed value after the final float voltage is reached. TP4056 Other features include current monitor, under voltage lockout, automatic recharge and two status pin to indicate charge termination and the presence of an input voltage.

The ULN2004 is a monolithic IC consists of seven NPN darlington transistor pairs with high voltage and current capability. It is commonly used for applications such as relay drivers, motor, display drivers, led lamp drivers, logic buffers, line drivers, hammer drivers and other high voltage current applications. It consists of common cathode clamp diodes for each NPN darlington pair which makes this driver IC useful for switching inductive loads.
Schematic Diagram of each Darlington Pair – ULN2003

The output of the driver is open collector and the collector current rating of each darlington pair is 500mA. Darlington pairs may be paralleled if higher current is required. The driver IC also consists of a 2.7KΩ base resistor for each darlington pair. Thus each darlington pair can be operated directly with TTL or 5V CMOS devices. This driver IC can be used for high voltage applications up to 50V.

Note that the driver provides open collector output, so it can only sink current, cannot source. Thus when a 5V is given to 1B terminal, 1C terminal will be connected to ground via darlington pair and the maximum current that it can handle is 500A. From the above logic diagram we can see that cathode of protection diodes are shorted to 9th pin called COM. So for driving inductive loads, it must connected to the supply voltage. Datasheet

blocks.text: DRV8825 Stepper Motor Driver with Aluminum Heat Sink
The DRV8825 Stepper Motor Driver with Aluminum Heat Sink is a breakout board for TI’s DRV8825 microstepping bipolar stepper motor driver.

The module has a pinout and interface that are nearly identical to those of the stepper motor driver carriers, so it can be used as a higher-performance drop-in replacement for those boards in many applications.

The features adjustable current limiting, overcurrent, and overtemperature protection, and six microstep resolutions (down to 1/32-step). It operates from 8.2 – 45 V and can deliver up to approximately 1.5 A per phase without a heat sink or forced air flow (rated for up to 2.2 A per coil with sufficient additional cooling).
Simple step and direction control interface
Six different step resolutions: full-step, half-step, 1/4-step, 1/8-step, 1/16-step, and 1/32-step
Adjustable current control lets you set the maximum current output with a potentiometer. Hence lets you use voltages above your stepper motor’s rated voltage to achieve higher step rates
Intelligent chopping control that automatically selects the correct current decay mode (fast decay or slow decay)
Built-in regulator (no external logic voltage supply needed)
Can interface directly with 3.3 V and 5 V systems
Over-temperature thermal shutdown, over-current shutdown, and under-voltage lockout
4-layer, 2 oz copper PCB for improved heat dissipation
Exposed solderable ground pad below the driver IC on the bottom of the PCB

blocks.text: This Infrared Obstacle Avoidance Sensor Module is an inexpensive solution to avoidance detection for robotics and other electronics uses.

It comes as an assembled module, as shown above, there are only four pins: +5-volts, GND, output, and EN. Output is an active LOW and has an onboard status LED. It’s very easy to interface directly with Arduino or other micro-controllers. It also works with the Raspberry Pi with a voltage range of 3-6 volts. Connect Vcc to 3-volts!

The enable pin “EN” will disable the device when HI (Vcc) and enable when LO (GND). The onboard jumper can be left open to allow external control of enable/disable of the module. I see no use for this function and would leave the jumper on and the pin disconnected. There are two potentiometers on the module one controlling operating frequency (centred at 38 kHz) the other controlling intensity. The detector was designed for 38 kHz and the onboard oscillator circuit is based on a 555 timer. Tweaking gives a little better range but I’d suggest leaving it alone because the useful range is narrow. It worked well as is. The maximum reliable range in my test was around 30-40 cm and depended on the type of material. A smooth white surface worked far better than a black or rough surface.

makers-556286.summary: The TIP142 is an STMicroelectronics NPN Darlington transistor rated at 100V and 10A, offering high gain and an integrated diode in a TO-247 power package.

blocks.text: Tip142 NPN Darlington Bipolar Power Transistor 100V 10A TO-247

The TIP142 belongs to a complementary family of bipolar Darlington devices documented by STMicroelectronics. It is the NPN member of the family, while the TIP147 is the corresponding PNP device. The TIP142 is a discrete semiconductor component organized around base, collector, and emitter connections. Its designation is also used as the marking on the component, clearly identifying the device within the manufacturer’s product range.

STMicroelectronics describes its construction as planar technology with a “base island” layout. The internal arrangement is monolithic, meaning the Darlington structure is formed inside one semiconductor component rather than connected from two separately packaged transistors. A Darlington arrangement combines two transistor stages into one functional unit. This internal organization distinguishes the TIP142 from a conventional single-transistor arrangement and establishes the relationship between the input connection and the collector-emitter current path.
Planar semiconductor technology with base-island layout.
Complementary design with the TIP147 PNP transistor.

makers-500263.summary: LM1893N is a half-duplex carrier-current transceiver IC that FSK-modulates a 50–300 kHz carrier onto AC power lines and PLL-demodulates received data.

blocks.text: LM1893N Carrier-Current Transceiver RH IC DIP-18

The LM1893N is a bipolar carrier-current transceiver IC that uses building AC power mains as the communications medium for half-duplex serial data links. It implements a current-controlled oscillator whose output is shaped to a low-RFI sinusoid, and the chip provides the on-chip drive needed to couple an FSK carrier onto a power-line coupling transformer and through a coupling capacitor to the AC wiring.

In transmit mode the device FSK-modulates a 50–300 kHz carrier under control of baseband data; an internal automatic-level-control plus a robust output amplifier produce a controlled current into the tank/coupling network so the line sees a sinusoidal carrier with limited distortion. In receive mode the input from the coupling transformer passes a band-limited, Norton-style limiter and a PLL demodulator; an impulse-noise integrator and offset-cancel loop recover clean digital edges for the host controller.

The LM1893N is intended as the interface between digital controllers (microcontrollers/COPSTM) and the power line, enabling modest-rate serial links (hundreds to a few thousand baud) with strong impulse-noise immunity. The device is designed so external discrete components (transformer, coupling cap, loop-filter, impulse filter) let designers trade sensitivity, data rate, and noise rejection for their application.

makers-486293.summary: The M27C512 is a 512K (64Kx8) CMOS EPROM with a 120ns speed, in a 28-pin DIP package. It offers low power consumption.

blocks.text: The M27C512 is a 512 Kbit Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EPROM) integrated circuit, organized in a 65,536 x 8-bit structure. It is offered in two primary variants: an ultraviolet (UV) erasable version, which allows for multiple reprogramming cycles, and a One Time Programmable (OTP) version for permanent code storage. The device is designed to provide a reliable and flexible non-volatile memory solution for systems where fast development and code experimentation are critical.

The chip’s operation is managed through a two-line control system consisting of Chip Enable (E) and Output Enable (G). This architecture is ideal for use in larger memory arrays, as it minimizes power dissipation and prevents output bus contention. The M27C512 features a low-power CMOS standby mode, significantly reducing current consumption when the device is not selected. For programming, it utilizes a specialized algorithm and requires a specific programming voltage to write data into the memory cells.

The device is available in several packages, including the PDIP28 (Plastic Dual In-line Package) which is a through-hole design. The UV-erasable version comes in a ceramic package (FDIP28W) with a transparent window. Exposing this window to short-wave ultraviolet light erases the entire memory content, resetting all bits to a logical ‘1’ state and preparing the device for a new program cycle, a key feature for development and debugging.

makers-415365.summary: MUR1660CT is a dual ultrafast recovery diode (600V, 8A) with a common cathode in a TO-220 package, ideal for high-speed rectification and power circuits.

blocks.text: MUR1660CT Diode Array 1 Pair Common Cathode 600V 8A Through Hole TO-220

The MUR1660CT is a high-speed, dual ultrafast recovery diode designed for high-frequency power applications requiring rapid switching and efficient energy management. Packaged in a TO-220-3 through-hole case, this diode array consists of two 8A diodes with a common cathode configuration, making it ideal for use in push-pull and center-tap transformer circuits where symmetrical current handling is essential.

Rated for 600 volts of repetitive reverse voltage and a continuous forward current of 8 amps per diode (16A total), the MUR1660CT delivers excellent performance in harsh environments and demanding power electronics systems. One of its key advantages is its ultrafast reverse recovery time, typically around 50 nanoseconds, which significantly reduces switching losses in high-frequency circuits such as switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), DC-DC converters, and motor drive inverters. This also helps improve overall system efficiency and reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI).

The device features a low forward voltage drop (typically around 1.2V at 8A), minimizing power dissipation and allowing it to operate with lower thermal output. Combined with the TO-220 package’s strong thermal characteristics and capability for heatsink mounting, it ensures reliable operation even at elevated temperatures up to 150°C junction temperature.

The LM358DR is a compact, industry-standard SOIC-8 packaged dual operational amplifier designed for use in single-supply and split-supply systems. Packaged for surface-mount assembly, the device integrates two independent, high-gain, frequency-compensated amplifiers in one small footprint, making it convenient for space-constrained PCBs where two op-amps are required.

blocks.text: The 7421 (GD74LS21 / SN74LS21 family) contains two independent positive-AND gates, each with four inputs. Each gate produces a HIGH only when all four inputs on that gate are HIGH, letting designers combine multiple control or sensor signals into a single logic enable or decision line. The device is part of the 74LS (Low-power Schottky TTL) family and is pin-compatible with standard 14-pin DIP/SOIC packages, so it’s easy to drop into breadboards, PCBs or existing TTL designs.

Because it’s a TTL LS device, the GD74LS21 is optimized for direct interfacing with other TTL/CMOS logic while offering reasonable output drive for typical logic loads. Typical uses include gating multiple control signals (interrupt enables, chip-select gating), building simple combinational logic without a microcontroller, glue logic between subsystems, or extending bus control where multiple conditions must be true before an action occurs. The part is widely available in PDIP, SOIC and other package options, and is characterized for standard commercial temperature ranges.

An LM741 operational amplifier is a DC-coupled high gain electronic voltage amplifier. It has only one op-amp inside. An operational amplifier IC is used as a comparator which compares the two signal, the inverting and non-inverting signal. The main function of this IC is to do mathematical operation in various circuits. Op-amps have large gain and usually used as Voltage Amplifier. The LM741 can operate with a single or dual power supply voltage.
An op-amp can be used in two ways:

When input source is connected to inverting terminal PIN 2 and feedback with the output PIN 6 then the op-amp is in inverting condition. Like if PIN 2 is having +ve polarity then we will get –ve polarity of output from PIN 6.

When input source is connected to non-inverting terminal PIN 3 and PIN 2 is feedback with the output PIN 6 then the op-amp is in non-inverting condition. Like if PIN 3 is having +ve polarity then we will get +ve polarity of output from PIN 6.

When voltage at non-inverting input (+) is higher than the voltage at inverting input (-), then the output of comparator is HIGH. And if the voltage of inverting input (-) is Higher than non-inverting end (+), then output is LOW. The output of the operational amplifier is the product of the gain and the input voltage.
In Op-amp IC 741, PIN2 is an inverting input terminal and PIN3 is non-inverting input terminal. The output pin of this IC is PIN6.

blocks.text: The TEC1-12715 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 15A Peltier Module is the simple application of Peltier Thermoelectric Effect. The module features 127 semiconductor couples in the area of 40mmx40mm.

Thermoelectric coolers also are known as TEC or Peltier Module create a temperature differential on each side. One side gets hot and the other side gets cool. Therefore, they can be used to either warm something up or cool something down, depending on which side you use. You can also take advantage of a temperature differential to generate electricity.

This Peltier works very well as long as you remove the heat from the hot side. After turning on the device, the hot side will heat quickly, the cold side will cool quickly. If you do not remove the heat from the hot side (with a heat sink or other device), the Peltier will quickly reach stasis and do nothing. We recommend using an old computer CPU heatsink or another block of metal to pull heat from the hot side. We were able to use a computer power supply and CPU heatsink to make the cold side so uncomfortable we could not hold our finger to it.

A thermoelectric cooling (TEC) module is a semiconductor-based electronic component that functions as a small heat pump. By applying the DC power source to a TEC, heat will be transferred from one side of the module to the other. It creates a cold and hot side. They are widely used in industrial areas, for example, computer CPU, CCDs, portable refrigerators, medical instruments, and so on.

بطارية ليثيوم أيون قابلة لإعادة الشحن 12.6 فولت 30 أمبير

تمثل بطارية 12.6 فولت 30 أمبير تفريغ عالي خيارًا قويًا وعمليًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى مصدر طاقة قابل لإعادة الشحن بسعة كبيرة وقدرة ممتازة على تزويد الأحمال بالتيار المطلوب. فهي تجمع بين سعة 30 أمبير وقدرة تفريغ تصل إلى 40 أمبير، مما يجعلها مناسبة للمشاريع والأنظمة التي تحتاج إلى وقت تشغيل أطول وأداء مستقر تحت الأحمال المرتفعة.

تعتمد البطارية على تكوين 3S10P، وهو تصميم يساعد على توزيع الحمل الكهربائي بصورة أفضل بين الخلايا، مما يدعم استقرار التيار ويحسن الأداء أثناء التشغيل. كما يساهم هذا التكوين في تحقيق توازن جيد بين السعة الكبيرة وكفاءة التشغيل، مع قدرة أفضل على التعامل مع التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى سحب مرتفع للتيار.

هذه البطارية مناسبة لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات مثل الأجهزة الإلكترونية ذات الطلب العالي، وأنظمة الإضاءة المحمولة، ومعدات الاتصال، وبعض التطبيقات المعتمدة على المحركات، وكذلك أنظمة الطاقة الاحتياطية والمشاريع الهندسية المختلفة. وتوفر حلًا موثوقًا للأشخاص الذين يحتاجون إلى بطارية قوية بجهد 12.6 فولت تجمع بين الاعتمادية والسعة والأداء العملي.

كما تحتوي البطارية على نظام حماية داخلي يساعد في تقليل المخاطر المرتبطة بالشحن الزائد، والتفريغ الزائد، والقصر الكهربائي، مما يدعم مستوى الأمان أثناء الاستخدام ويحسن من موثوقية البطارية مع الاستخدام المتكرر.
إذا كنت بحاجة إلى بطارية قابلة للشحن توفر قدرة عالية وسعة كبيرة في نفس الوقت، فإن هذه البطارية تمثل اختيارًا ممتازًا للعديد من تطبيقات 12 فولت الاحترافية والعملية.

blocks.text: Compact Step-Down Transformer 220VAC to 6V-0-6V AC 300mA – 3 Wire Center-Tapped Output

This compact step-down transformer converts a 220V AC mains input into a center-tapped 6V-0-6V AC output through three secondary wires. It is suitable for low-power electronic circuits, educational kits, signal-processing projects, and small power-supply designs that require a symmetrical low-voltage AC source.

Each outer secondary wire provides approximately 6V AC relative to the center-tap wire, while the voltage measured between the two outer wires is approximately 12V AC. After adding a suitable rectifier, smoothing capacitors, and voltage regulation, the transformer can be used to build single-rail or positive and negative DC power supplies.

blocks.text: 4 DOF Aluminum Robot Arm with 4 MG996 Servo Motors – Assembled Mechanical Robotic Arm Frame with Gripper

The 4 DOF Aluminum Robot Arm with 4 MG996 Servo Motors is a strong and practical robotic manipulator arm designed for users who want a ready mechanical platform for robotics, servo motion control, gripper experiments, automation training, and educational projects. Built from aluminum alloy parts and fitted with four MG996 metal gear servo motors, this robotic arm provides a solid base for creating pick-and-place systems, robotic control demonstrations, programmable arm movement, Arduino-based experiments, microcontroller projects, and mechanical motion learning.

Unlike loose DIY kits that require full mechanical assembly, this version is supplied as an assembled robotic arm frame with the servo motors already installed. The arm structure, gripper, joints, base plates, and servo mounting points are already mounted together, making it easier for students, makers, robotics beginners, and developers to start working on the control system instead of spending extra time assembling the frame. The product is ideal for users who already have their own Arduino board, servo controller, microcontroller, power supply, or custom control circuit.

The 4 DOF Aluminum Robot Arm with 4 MG996 Servo Motors includes four degrees of freedom, allowing movement through multiple joints. Each servo position can be controlled using a compatible control signal from a microcontroller or servo controller. The MG996 servo motors are widely used in robotics because they provide strong torque, metal gears, and stable mechanical performance for medium-load robotic applications. The arm also includes a mechanical claw gripper that can open and close to hold small objects during testing and demonstration.

This product is suitable for Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, STM32, robotics control boards, servo testers, PCA9685 servo driver modules, and other PWM control systems, as long as the user provides a suitable external power supply and correct signal wiring. Since servo motors can draw high current, especially under load, it is recommended to use a dedicated external 5V to 6V power supply with enough current capacity rather than powering all servos directly from a microcontroller board.

The arm body is made from aluminum alloy parts, giving it better strength than plastic educational arms. The black metal base and arm links provide a stable structure for lab work, classroom demonstrations, graduation projects, small automation models, and prototype robotic systems. The silver aluminum gripper provides a lightweight claw mechanism with an approximate maximum opening of 52mm / 5.2cm, suitable for holding lightweight objects, small components, foam blocks, plastic parts, and demonstration items.

Based on the supplied photos, the assembled arm reaches an approximate vertical height of 35.5cm, and the maximum forward extension is approximately 25cm. The gripper assembly has an approximate closed total length of 115mm, and the maximum overall gripper width when opened is approximately 100mm. These dimensions make the arm suitable for desktop robotics projects where compact size and visible movement are important.

The installed MG996 servo motors support a working voltage range of 4.8V to 6V, with typical no-load response speeds around 0.17 sec/60° at 4.8V and 0.14 sec/60° at 6V. The servo body size is approximately 40.7 × 19.9 × 42.9mm. The servos use metal gears and can rotate up to approximately 180 degrees, depending on the control signal, mechanical limits, and mounting position. This gives the robotic arm a wide movement range for educational control experiments and programmed motion sequences.

The 4 DOF Aluminum Robot Arm with 4 MG996 Servo Motors is not a complete electronic robot kit. It is a mechanical robotic arm platform with pre-installed servos. To operate it, the user must connect it to a compatible controller, such as an Arduino board, servo driver, microcontroller, wireless control system, joystick control circuit, potentiometer controller, or custom automation board. The controller, power supply, code, and wiring accessories are not included in this product.

This makes the arm a flexible choice for users who want to design their own control method. It can be used with manual potentiometer control, Arduino programming, Bluetooth control, Wi-Fi control, serial control, computer-based control, machine vision projects, or basic automation sequences. It is also suitable for learning servo calibration, PWM signal control, inverse kinematics basics, robotic joint movement, mechanical leverage, gripper control, and multi-axis movement coordination.

For best performance, use a stable external power supply rated for the total current required by the servos. When multiple MG996 servo motors move at the same time, the current demand can be high. A supply rated around 5V to 6V with sufficient current capacity is recommended depending on load and movement pattern. The signal ground of the power supply and controller should be common to ensure stable servo operation.

This product is recommended for educational labs, engineering students, robotics clubs, electronics workshops, makers, Arduino learners, prototype developers, and anyone building a small robotic manipulator system. It is also useful as a spare mechanical arm platform for users who already own controllers and need only the assembled arm with servos.

يعمل هذا المحرك بتيار 1.5 أمبير لكل فازة، ويوفر عزم تثبيت 42 نيوتن.سم، لذلك فهو مناسب لعدد كبير من التطبيقات مثل الطابعات ثلاثية الأبعاد، وماكينات الحفر سي إن سي، وآلات الليزر، وماكينات الكتابة والرسم، وأنظمة الحركة الخطية الصغيرة، ومشروعات الأتمتة. كما أن وجود كابل دوبونت ضمن العبوة يجعل التوصيل مع لوحات التحكم ودرايفرات المحركات أسهل وأسرع، خاصة في مشروعات التطوير والتركيب والاستبدال.

ومن الصور المرفقة يتضح أن هذا الموديل يأتي بتصميم 4 أسلاك، مع كونكتور 6 بنات من جهة المحرك، ويعتمد المقاس القياسي المعروف لمحركات نيما 17. كما تُظهر رسومات الأبعاد في الصور أن الواجهة الأمامية للمحرك حوالي 42.3 مم كحد أقصى، والمسافة بين فتحات التثبيت 31 مم تقريبًا، مع 4 فتحات تثبيت بمقاس إم 3، وعمود دوران بقطر 5 مم. ويظهر أيضًا أن طول العمود البارز حوالي 18 مم، بينما طول جسم المحرك نفسه يقارب 48 مم كحد أقصى حسب رسم المورد.

هذا المحرك مناسب جدًا للأنظمة التي تتطلب تكرارًا دقيقًا للحركة وتموضعًا ثابتًا. زاوية الخطوة 1.8 درجة تمنحه دقة جيدة في التحكم، كما أن تصميمه الهجين يساعد على تحقيق أداء سلس وثابت. وتوضح صور المورد أيضًا أنه مصمم ليقدم تشغيلًا مستقرًا، ومستوى ضوضاء منخفضًا، وبنية قوية مناسبة للاستخدام المستمر في الماكينات المختلفة. كما أن القوائم العامة المنشورة لهذا الموديل تتوافق مع كونه من عائلة محركات 17HS4401 الشائعة للاستخدام في الطابعات ثلاثية الأبعاد وماكينات سي إن سي والليزر.

blocks.text: The new official Raspberry Pi High Quality Camera module (HQ Camera) for the Raspberry Pi is here – take your Raspberry Pi camera projects up a gear with the 12-megapixel Sony sensor, integrated aluminium tripod mount and interchangeable lens compatibility!

The incredible new High Quality (HQ) Camera module from Raspberry Pi offers a higher resolution (12 megapixels, compared to 8 megapixels), and sensitivity (approximately 50% greater area per pixel for improved low-light performance) than the Camera Module v2.

It features a Sony IMX477 sensor, a 200mm FPC cable for connection to your Raspberry Pi, a milled aluminium lens mount with integrated 1/4” -20 tripod mount and focus adjustment ring, and a C- to CS-mount adapter.
A lens cover is also included with the module and comes pre-fitted. There’s even a small screwdriver in the box for making adjustments.

It’s designed to work with interchangeable lenses in both C- and CS-mount form factors giving you ultimate flexibility with your Raspberry Pi camera projects. A C-CS mount adapter comes pre-fitted to the module.
The High Quality (HQ) Camera uses the same commands as the standard Raspberry Pi Camera Module, such as libcamera (or raspistill/raspivid if you’re using Buster or an even older OS image)
libcamera and similar commands will query the camera firmware for the resolution of the sensors (as they already do today) and will default to 12 megapixels for the High Quality Camera.
The drivers for the High Quality (HQ) Camera are built-in to Raspberry Pi OS too, so upgrading your camera project with the High Quality Camera is a simple task.

A huge range of popular projects from time-lapse photography to Raspberry Pi CCTV-style systems can be made double-awesome with the new High Quality Camera module. Shoot in greater detail, with improved low-light performance and take advantage of the range of available lenses to get the perfect shot.

The High Quality Camera provides an alternative to the Camera Module v2 for industrial and consumer applications, including security cameras which require the highest levels of visual fidelity and/or integration with specialist optics.
The High Quality (HQ) Camera is compatible with all models of the Raspberry Pi from the Raspberry Pi 1 Model B onwards, using the latest Raspbian software release.

blocks.text: CNC 3D Printer Mech Endstop Switch uses a lever switch to detect when it is activated. The switch is wired up so that when activated, it pulls the signal to LOW. The mechanical endstop is a simple solution to a simple problem. We want to be able to detect when an X/Y/Z stage has reached its minimum or maximum. Instead of messing with flags or complicated light beam interruption, we use a mechanical switch.

If we place the switch in the path of the stage, then the stage itself will simply close the switch when it moves against it. blocks.text: The E18-D80NK Photoelectric Sensor is an adjustable infrared proximity switch designed for non-contact object detection. It combines an infrared transmitter, receiver and control circuit inside a compact threaded cylindrical housing.

The sensor emits infrared light toward the target. When an object enters the selected detection range, part of the light reflects toward the internal receiver. ✅ Broad compatibility — positive photoresist dry film and presensitized boards from common brands.
✅ Compact & economical — 125 mL covers up to ~400 cm² of pure PCB area.
✅ Clear, light-yellow liquid — easy to see development progress in the tray.
🔹 Net Capacity: 125 mL clear, light-yellow developer in a plastic bottle with screw cap
🔹 Typical Dimensions (bottle): ~90 mm height × ~45 mm diameter (for reference)
🧩 Resists: Positive photoresist coatings and photosensitive dry film sheets
🧪 Etchants: Works with typical etchants after development (e.g., ferric chloride, cupric chloride, persulfate systems)
⚙️ 1) After exposure: Shake bottle gently. Pour a small amount into a plastic or glass tray—no dilution.
⚙️ 2) Develop: Immerse the board at room temperature. Use a soft brush with smooth strokes until the exposed resist lifts (≈5 min).
⚙️ 3) Rinse thoroughly: Wash the PCB with water to stop action and remove residues.
⚙️ 4) Etch copper: Proceed to the etching stage only after a clean rinse and inspection of features.
⚙️ 5) Post-etch rinse: Before any stripping steps, rinse again to keep the process stable.
💡 Don’t over-develop: Remove only the exposed resist—masked areas must stay intact and glossy.
💡 Agitation beats heat: Gentle brushing accelerates development evenly without risking swelling.
💡 Lighting: Normal room light is fine after exposure; avoid intense UV sources near the tray.
💡 Edge fidelity: Keep board flat; support corners to prevent pooling which can soften edges.
💡 Inspection cue: Tracks should appear bright copper while masked zones remain covered; magnify fine pitch to confirm integrity.
💡 Warm-up option: If you need a small speed boost, indirectly warm the sealed bottle by placing it in 30–40 °C water for a short time—never heat directly.
💡 Tray choice: Use light-colored plastic to better see progress; avoid metal containers.
💡 Discipline: Always rinse before etching and again before any resist stripping to keep chemistry clean.
🧤 Wear disposable gloves and eye protection.
🚫 Do not breathe any vapors or aerosols generated during brushing.
🧒 Keep out of reach of children.
🔒 Keep the cap tightly closed when not in use.
👁️ In case of eye/skin contact: rinse with plenty of water.
🔥 Do not place on direct heat; store away from heat and sunlight.
⛔ Not an etchant; it does not remove copper.
⛔ Not intended to be diluted or mixed with other chemicals.

microohm-137.summary: Contains four independent 2-input OR gates Operates at standard 5V TTL logic levels Fast switching with low propagation delay Low power consumption Comes in 14-pin DIP or SMD packages

blocks.text: The SN74LS32N Quad 2-Input OR Gate IC DIP-14 5V 8mA TTL Logic is a high-speed digital logic integrated circuit belonging to the 74LS (Low Power Schottky TTL) family. It contains four independent OR gates, each performing the Boolean OR operation, where the output becomes HIGH when at least one input is HIGH.

The 74×32 gives you four basic OR gates that can be used individually. An OR gate is a logic gate that outputs 1 (HIGH) if one of its inputs are 1 (HIGH). In the truth table below, you can see what the output will be for any given input:
The truth table for the OR gate

Like every other chip in the 7400 series, this IC needs to be connected to power before you can use it. Most 7400 ICs support a VCC voltage of 5V. One difference between the HC and LS versions of the chip is that the 74HC32 supports 2V to 6V, while the 74LS32 supports only 5V.
Once it’s connected, you can use any of the four basic OR gates inside.
Each gate output of the 74HC32 can sink or source 4 mA when powered with 5V.
Quad 2-input OR gates in a single IC.
Low power Schottky (LS) technology for reduced power consumption.

blocks.text: The Buck 8A XL4106 is a high-current, step-down DC-DC converter module featuring adjustable output voltage and current limiting. The onboard potentiometers enable user adjustment of both the output voltage and current threshold, making it suitable for powering demanding loads where precise control is required.

This module employs a constant-voltage, constant-current (CV/CC) control mechanism, allowing it to function as a general-purpose power supply or a dedicated battery charger. The current adjustment feature provides protection against overloads, limiting the maximum current drawn by the load. Its robust design and high conversion efficiency help reduce heat dissipation, ensuring stable operation under sustained load conditions.

ekostra-28123.summary: The JGA25-370 (6V, 170RPM) is a premium, all-metal DC gear motor equipped with a rear-mounted magnetic quadrature encoder. Delivering reliable torque and precise rotational feedback, it is the ideal choice for closed-loop control systems, robotics odometry, smart cars, and precision automation projects.

blocks.text: The JGA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Magnetic Encoder bridges the gap between simple DC motors and complex stepper motors by offering high-torque continuous rotation with precise positional feedback. Built around a standard 370-size DC motor and a 25mm all-metal gearbox, this motor operates at a nominal 6V to deliver a smooth 170 RPM at the output shaft.

What sets this motor apart is its integrated dual-channel Hall-effect magnetic encoder. By reading the quadrature pulse outputs (Channel A and Channel B), microcontrollers like Arduino, ESP32, or Raspberry Pi can calculate the motor’s exact speed, direction of rotation, and distance traveled. This makes it a perfect component for balancing robots, precise maze-solvers, PID speed controllers, and advanced automated machinery where blind rotation is not enough.
Closed-Loop Control Ready: The built-in magnetic Hall-effect encoder allows for precise speed tracking (RPM), position monitoring, and rotational direction sensing.
All-Metal Gearbox: Highly durable internal metal gears ensure a long lifespan, reduced wear, and the ability to handle stalls and high-torque loads better than plastic counterparts.
Standard D-Shaft: Features a 4mm D-shaped output shaft, ensuring a slip-free connection with a wide variety of wheels, pulleys, and shaft couplers.
Compact & Powerful: The 25mm diameter profile makes it easy to mount in tight chassis spaces while still delivering substantial pushing power for medium-sized robots.
6-Pin Interface: Comes with a neat 6-pin wiring terminal separating motor power from encoder logic, ensuring clean signals and safe microcontroller integration.

ekostra-13790.summary: 74183 dual carry-save full adder, TTL logic Two independent 1-bit full adders in one chip Each adder takes A, B and carry-in and gives sum and carry-out 5V supply, DIP-14 through-hole package Used in multipliers, fast multi-operand adders and logic labs

blocks.text: The 74183 is a TTL integrated circuit that contains two independent carry-save full adders in one 14-pin DIP package. Each adder adds three 1-bit inputs (A, B and a carry input) and produces a sum output and a carry output. Several 74183 adders can be arranged as carry-save adders to add many binary numbers at the same time, the technique used in fast multipliers and multi-operand adders.
Adders per chip: 2 independent 1-bit full adders
Inputs per adder: A, B and carry in
Outputs per adder: sum and carry out
Each adder follows the full adder truth table: the sum output is 1 when an odd number of the three inputs are 1, and the carry output is 1 when two or more of the inputs are 1.
Carry-save adder stages in digital multipliers
Fast addition of several binary numbers
Full adder experiments in digital logic labs

Place a 0.1µF capacitor between VCC and GND close to the chip.
Do not leave unused TTL inputs floating; tie them to a defined logic level.

blocks.text: The CD4029 is a binary-decade up/down counter IC, selectable between binary (base-2) and decade (base-10) counting modes, counting either upward or downward depending on its control inputs.

This dual-mode flexibility lets a single IC serve either as a binary counter or a decimal (BCD) counter depending on how it’s configured, reducing the need for separate binary and decade counter ICs in mixed designs.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family, this IC is a standard building block for flexible counting circuits.
